title: PostgreSQL Connection Pool Exhaustion
symptoms: FATAL: remaining connection slots are reserved; TimeoutError acquiring connection from pool; HTTP 503
root_cause: A traffic spike or unclosed database connections used up all available DB slots.
remediation: Check idle connections in pg_stat_activity, restart leaking worker pods, or increase pool size.

title: Out of Memory (OOMKilled) Container
symptoms: Exit code 137; OOMKilled; Memory usage exceeded container limit
root_cause: A heavy job or memory leak exceeded the container RAM limit.
remediation: Inspect recent large-payload requests, stream files instead of loading into RAM, or raise the memory limit.

title: Brute-Force Login Spike
symptoms: 401 Unauthorized repeated from single IP; Failed password for invalid user; >50 failed logins in 60s
root_cause: Automated credential stuffing or brute-force attack hitting /login.
remediation: Block the source IP at the firewall/WAF and verify rate limiting is enabled.

title: Normal Healthy Traffic
symptoms: 200 OK; Healthcheck passed; User logged in successfully; Cache hit; Scheduled job completed
